title: Kconfig LICHEN_TDMA help cites stale slot formula hash(EUI64^epoch); spec/link.h say fnv1a32(EUI64)+SFN, epoch MUST NOT enter hash
description: lichen/subsys/lichen/link/Kconfig LICHEN_TDMA help text says slot=hash(EUI64^epoch)%num_slots via lichen_hash_32. Authoritative sources (spec/02a-coordinated-capacity.md 2a.2 and link.h LICHEN_TDMA_SLOT_MS comment) specify Slot=(fnv1a32(EUI64)+u32(SFN)) mod n and state the epoch MUST NOT enter the hash. Reword the help text to match. Discovered during project-LICHEN-worker6-rap6 guard-doc sweep (guard=100ms portion of that line already fixed to 50ms).
close_reason: Kconfig help text corrected to spec/02a 2a.2 formula
